items.question: What arises when the hidden true nature is known?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature produces all-knowingness.
items.inference: Realization of concealed true nature gives omniscience.
uncertainties: The accusative gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ is the object of jñātvā; its exact referent is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
